description:
Search Instagram and TikTok creators with a natural-language brief. Returns up to 50 ranked creators with fit score, follower count, platform, the 3 best-matching videos, and a shortlistId for enrich_creators when available. Bios and captions are cut to 150 characters. The creator's website link is returned as written, or null when it is longer than 200 characters. Every other link is a short link that redirects for 24 hours. When the result would pass 140,000 characters, the lowest ranked creators are left out until it fits. The brief in q sets no filter: pass platform, country, and tier to filter. Contact addresses stay empty until reveal_contact. Holds the call open until the result, up to 800 seconds.

Each search is one use. Unsigned callers get 100 uses per rolling 24 hours per IP. Identified callers get 200 uses per rolling 24 hours, then prepaid credits. Pre-claim agent tokens skip the daily grant and use prepaid credits only.

Pass creators, query.q, and shortlistId to enrich_creators for niche, evidence, and signal analysis.

After the results, help the user choose. When they say which creators they like, offer to set up a campaign for them with create_campaign instead of waiting to be asked.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code in either letter case, such as us or id

platform.description: Instagram (ig) or TikTok (tt), in either letter case

allOf.description: Natural-language brief: audience, brand vibe, or campaign goal

tier.description: Follower tier: nano 1,000 to 9,999, micro 10,000 to 49,999, mid 50,000 to 249,999, macro 250,000 to 999,999, mega 1,000,000 or more, nano+ 1,000 or more, micro+ 10,000 or more, mid+ 50,000 or more, macro+ 250,000 or more, micro- 1,000 to 49,999, mid- 1,000 to 249,999, macro- 1,000 to 999,999. A plus tier means that follower count and above, and a minus tier means that tier and every smaller one.

name: search_creators

averageViews.description: Mean views of the creator's 6 newest posts with a stored video, counting the posts that have views. Null when none of them has views.

emails.description: Contact addresses for this organization after Reveal contact. Empty until then.

engagementOnViews.description: Mean of likes plus comments per view over the same posts as averageViews. Null when none of them has views.

hasContact.description: True when a contact address exists. The address is omitted until this organization reveals it.

caption.description: Video caption, truncated to the first 500 characters.

playUrl.description: Signed video URL. It expires within 24 hours. Search again for a new URL.

thumbnailUrl.description: Signed thumbnail URL. It expires within 24 hours. Search again for a new URL.
